title: Grateful Dead Live at Market Square Arena on 1981-12-05
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 08/2017
source: AUD: Beyers mics > lead deck (Richie Stankiewicz) > Sony TC-D5 > Hitachi UD-90's, FOB recording by Craig L (patched out).

ai_review.summary: Outstanding front‑of‑house audience tape captures a wildly intense December 5 1981 show hailed as one of the Dead’s all‑time best performances.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording, noting that the F.O.B. source is crystal‑clear and perfectly balanced, letting every instrument be heard. The concert itself is described as the "wildest, most intense" show of the era, ranking alongside legendary dates like 8/19/80 and 9/2/80. No specific song complaints are mentioned, making this a must‑have for any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly enthusiastic (4‑5 stars) and praise the performance as top‑tier while also lauding the recording quality, leading to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house tape is described as 'dialed in', crystal clear, with full instrument separation and audible crowd ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the overall intensity and historic stature of the show rather than specific set pacing; they deem it a high‑energy, must‑hear performance.
